description: For a new two-storey detached house with a building area of 180 m2, our wall has a foil-faced exterior insulation layer between the stud cavity and the cladding. The design location has 6,500 heating degree-days. At the innermost impermeable surface, the total RSI outboard is 0.5 and inboard is 4.0. Measured dry-cup vapour permeance is 5 ng/(Pa s m2), and air leakage is 0.02 L/(s m2) at 75 Pa. There is no air space inboard of that layer, it is not on the warm face, and indoor moisture generation is ordinary. We want to keep this arrangement.
known_facts: 6500 heating degree-days stated as design input
RSI outboard 0.5 and inboard 4.0 at innermost impermeable surface
air leakage 0.02 L/(s m2) at 75 Pa
